subtitle: iSTAMP Desktop
description: Cross-platform desktop classifier for Raman/SRH glioblastoma molecular subtyping (Nature Communications revision package).
raw_image_inference: Requires CONCH foundation model (not bundled); viewer + metadata + QC only.
data_bundling_note: best_model_full.pt is NOT auto-bundled by these scripts. Place a copy next to the executable or set RMC_CHECKPOINT. Patient SRH images are never bundled.
